patch_description: This crossover restores the exact-ratio hill-climbing stage from the stronger prior implementation while retaining the stable multi-start softmin/softmax Adam search from the current program. The smooth optimization efficiently discovers high-quality contact structures, and the final strictly improving hard-objective search corrects small surrogate-objective errors without ever accepting a decrease in the evaluator’s true squared-distance ratio. All randomness is seeded, and the returned value is always a finite `(14, 3)` NumPy array.
